description: Stay protected from harsh cold weather with Rothco’s Wintuck Acrylic Face Mask. Crafted from non-allergenic Wintuck acrylic, this face mask offers the warmth of wool without the itch, making it ideal for sensitive skin. Its lightweight and breathable construction ensures maximum comfort during extended wear, while the snug fit provides effective coverage for your face and neck. Proudly made in the USA, this durable face mask is designed to withstand tough outdoor conditions, from frigid mornings to brisk evening activities. Whether for outdoor sports, work, or casual wear, Rothco’s Wintuck Acrylic Face Mask is your go-to for reliable cold-weather protection.
